findings.question: indicator C1: Does the state operate its own government data centres that are in operation today?
findings.quote: Oficialios inauguracijos metu paskelbtas valstybinių duomenų centrų VDC3 ir VDC4 startas. Bendra abiejų centrų talpa – 288 spintos.
findings.quote_english: At the official inauguration the launch of state data centres VDC3 and VDC4 was announced. The combined capacity of both centres is 288 racks.
findings.value: Yes
findings.title: Valstybės duomenų centrų plėtros projektas
findings.publisher: AB Lietuvos radijo ir televizijos centras (Telecentras), state-owned
findings.note: The operator's own page replaces a press source. It dates the VDC3/VDC4 launch to 2024-09-30 and also says that the IVPK-run VDC1 and VDC2 already operate.

review.established: yes
review.reason: The page announces the start of state data centres VDC3 and VDC4, with 288 racks in total (dated 2024-09-30), and says VDC1 and VDC2 already operate, so state data centres are in operation.

findings.question: indicator C2: Is a national sovereign or government cloud platform in operation (not announced)?

findings.value: Yes
findings.title: Debesijos paslaugos
findings.publisher: AB Lietuvos radijo ir televizijos centras (Telecentras), state-owned
findings.note: The state-owned operator's page replaces a press source. The same page says its virtual resources run in the Tier III state data centres, and that the platform is built on Nutanix HCI, a US vendor's software.

review.established: yes
review.reason: Telecentras offers 'Telecentras Cloud', described as a national cloud platform spread over several geolocations, as a current service with private and hybrid options; it is presented as operating, not announced.

findings.question: indicator L1: Does a statute or binding regulation require government data (or classified government data) to be stored and processed under national or EU jurisdiction?
findings.quote: Pagal įstatymą viešojo sektoriaus organizacijos ir įstaigos turėtų duomenis laikyti valstybiniuose duomenų centruose, o esančios Saugaus valstybinio duomenų perdavimo tinklo (SVDPT) sąraše - privalo.
findings.quote_english: By law, public sector organisations and bodies should keep data in state data centres, and those on the Secure State Data Transmission Network (SVDPT) list must.
findings.value: Partly
findings.title: Valstybės duomenų centrų plėtros projektas
findings.publisher: AB Lietuvos radijo ir televizijos centras (Telecentras), state-owned
findings.note: The operator's official page supports 'Partly' better than the press article: storage in state data centres is mandatory only for bodies on the SVDPT list. It is not the statute itself.

review.established: partial
review.reason: The page says that under the law public-sector bodies 'should' keep data in state data centres and only those on the SVDPT list 'must', so the binding requirement covers a subset, and the page paraphrases the statute without naming it.

findings.question: indicator K1: Is the root of the government's public key infrastructure or its qualified trust service operated by the state or a state-controlled body?
findings.quote: Įregistruotas Lietuvos Respublikos ryšių reguliavimo tarnybos direktoriaus 2025 m. lapkričio 13 d. įsakymu Nr. TN- „Dėl Migracijos departamento prie Lietuvos Respublikos vidaus reikalų ministerijos registravimo kvalifikuotus sertifikatus sudarančiu sertifikavimo paslaugų teikėju“.

findings.value: Yes

findings.publisher: Lietuvos Respublikos ryšių reguliavimo tarnyba (RRT)

review.reason: RRT registered the Migration Department under the Ministry of the Interior, a state body, as a provider that issues qualified certificates, so a qualified trust service is state-operated; the quote does not name a PKI root.

findings.question: indicator K2: Is the national electronic identity scheme operated by the state or a state-controlled body?
